title: Cosy Cafe 0.14.2
author: Cosy Creator
font_credit: MiSans (c) 2020-2021 Beijing Xiaomi Mobile Software Co., Ltd.
_why_script_override: This game ships no game/tl/<lang>/ templates -- only game/tl/None/common.rpym -- so build_tl.py has nothing to compile and tools/install.py has nothing to place. The patch replaces 27 of the game's own .rpy files outright; patch/game/ mirrors the game's game/ directory. See docs/approach.md.
_why_ps1: tools/install.py only knows how to place a translation tree, a shim and fonts. This game needs a script-override installer, so it ships its own next to the patch.
_coverage_note: 32,639 player-visible literals, 100% translated. Counted from the game's English scripts, not from data/tl_trans.json -- that file is reverse-derived from the finished Chinese .rpy and is not a build input, so it cannot report coverage. No <b> tags anywhere in the game, so MiSans-Bold.ttf is only reached through zz_zh_locale.rpy's bold fallback.
